blocks.text: VitafusionTM GLP-1 Support gummy vitamins are designed with you in mind to support your GLP-1 journey. These tasty Citrus flavored GLP-1 Support gummy vitamins help fill nutritional gaps that can come from a reduced-calorie diet. Each 3-gummy serving provides an excellent source of fiber, plus vitamins D, B12, and folate. Vitamin D3 supports bone health(1) while Vitamin B12 and Folate support energy metabolism(1). These GLP-1 Support vitamin gummies are sugar free, and do not contain gluten, high fructose corn syrup, dairy, and synthetic FD&C dyes. Nourish your body(1) with vitafusion GLP-1 Support, the easy, delicious way to support your GLP-1 journey. (1)These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
